# Phosphor Icons

Official source: https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core

Pinned commit: `2b75f3ad12b420c9504ef05df8d2564a28f8500e`

Weight: Regular. License: MIT, preserved in LICENSE.

The SVG files in regular/ are unmodified upstream files selected by patterns/icons.json.
Run `python tools/fetch-icons.py` from the repository root to retrieve the pinned sources.
Run `node tools/build-icons.mjs` to produce the distribution assets and hashes.
